categories.main_business_segments: The company operates six main business groups: Power Business (including transformers, switchgear, motors, cables, smart meters, and energy-saving air conditioning), New Energy Business (solar power, energy storage, green electricity trading, charging stations), Information System Integration Business (AI, cloud, ESG-focused IT system integration), Consumer Electronics Business (home appliances and digital entertainment products), Real Estate Business (property management and development), and Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) Business (electronic components and computer hardware manufacturing).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as AI integration, smart grid and smart meter development, high-efficiency and energy-saving motor design, high-voltage transformer manufacturing, and solar photovoltaic system engineering. It uses automated and digitalized production processes, including IoT applications, cloud computing, and energy management systems. The company also emphasizes green manufacturing, RoHS compliance, and ISO certifications for quality and environmental management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies (e.g., Taiwan Power Company), industrial enterprises (steel, petrochemical, manufacturing), telecommunications operators, commercial and residential property developers, and end consumers for home appliances. The company serves domestic markets primarily in Taiwan and expands into international markets including Japan, Southeast Asia (Thailand, Malaysia), the US, China, and Europe, targeting sectors such as renewable energy, smart grid infrastructure, and digital transformation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with significant market presence in Japan, Southeast Asia (Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, Philippines), the United States, China, and Europe. It has manufacturing and sales facilities domestically and overseas, including investments in Thailand and Singapore, and actively pursues international project bids and partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, including product design, manufacturing, system integration, and after-sales services. It also engages in upstream activities such as sourcing raw materials and components from global suppliers and invests in energy generation assets (solar power plants). The company vertically integrates energy systems from generation to management and retail (green electricity trading).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding green energy and renewable energy solutions aligned with Taiwan's 2050 net-zero goals, advancing AI and digital transformation in ICT and energy sectors, developing high-efficiency and smart products (motors, transformers, smart meters), and enhancing system integration capabilities. R&D focuses on energy management systems, AI-enabled smart devices, microgrid and energy storage technologies, and sustainable manufacturing processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales (power equipment, consumer electronics, electronic components), system integration services, project-based engineering contracts (EPC for solar and energy projects), green electricity trading, licensing and technology cooperation, and real estate development. The company also earns income from after-sales services, maintenance, and energy management solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading integrated power equipment and energy solutions provider in Taiwan with a strong market share in transformers, smart meters, and motors. It competes with domestic and international manufacturers in power equipment, renewable energy, and electronics manufacturing. Its competitive advantages include comprehensive product lines, long-standing industry experience, strategic partnerships, and a focus on sustainability and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$47.5 billion and a net profit of NT$14.2 billion, reflecting significant growth compared to prior years. The company maintains a stable financial position with total assets around NT$144.7 billion and equity of NT$76.1 billion. It has shown resilience and profitability despite global economic challenges, supported by diversified business segments and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrated energy solutions combining power generation, transmission, and smart energy management to support sustainable development and net-zero carbon goals. It differentiates through advanced technology adoption (AI, IoT), comprehensive product portfolios covering power equipment to consumer electronics, strong quality certifications, and a commitment to environmental and social governance (ESG). Its ability to provide turnkey projects and customized solutions enhances customer value and market competitiveness.
